# Reintech

> A tech recruiting platform connecting high-growth companies with vetted remote developers, contractors, and specialized defense engineering talent.

Reintech offers integrated recruiting services, remote contractor hiring with payroll management, and specialized MilTech recruiting for mission-critical defense roles. The platform focuses on pre-screened candidates and fixed-fee hiring models for tech teams.

## Recruiting Services

- [Integrated Recruiting - Reintech](https://reintech.io/recruiting): Reintech's integrated recruiting service with pre-screened candidates
- [Hire Remote Developers - Reintech](https://reintech.io/contractors): Reintech's remote developer hiring with vetted engineers and payroll
- [MilTech Recruiting - Reintech](https://reintech.io/miltech): Reintech's specialized recruiting for mission-critical defense engineering
